Job Description

Associate Product Manager
About Flipkart
Flipkart is Indiaʼs homegrown e-commerce powerhouse, with over 500 million customers, that is
empowering the dreams of a billion Indians through its solutions, every day. Selling over 150 million
products across 80+ categories with an ability to reach 100% of Indiaʼs serviceable pin codes, our scale
is unprecedented and a perfect match for your ambition.
Everything worth doing in life is worth taking a leap for. So come, take a leap into our world of
maximization, where youʼll find a culture that blends high ownership, fearless experimentation, and
exhilarating learning. Flipkart has been certified as a Great Place to Work, because at Flipkart every day
is about maximizing impact - for you, and for India.
Flipkart is a part of the Walmart-owned Flipkart Group, which also includes group companies Myntra,
Flipkart Wholesale, and Cleartrip.

Early Careers at Flipkart
Are you ready to turn your potential into performance?
Early Careers at Flipkart are all about bold beginnings and limitless possibilities. Whether youʼre an intern
or a fresh graduate, youʼll get a chance to work on real problems, with real impact that touches the lives
of over a billion Indians. Donʼt just walk into your first career, leap into it.

What youʼll get
Solve Real Problems
Youʼll work on live projects that make a real impact on India.
Learn From the Best
Get mentored by the people behind one of Indiaʼs OG start-ups.
Own Your Journey
We give you the canvas, you bring the vision.
A Culture that Excites & Enables
Feel inspired while also being cared for.

Quite possibly, the best thing about leaping into our world of maximization is that every leap counts no matter where you come from or what your journey looks like. Weʼve built a workplace where
diversity is celebrated and inclusion is non-negotiable.

Your leap is welcomed, valued, and championed here at Flipkart.

About the Leap
This is an opportunity to join Flipkart's Associate Product Manager (APM) program, an elite two-year
rotational initiative designed for young technologists. Post your performance review each year, there is an
auto-progression to next grade with compensation increment as well. As an APM, you'll gain comprehensive
exposure across Flipkart's core business disciplines, wielding signiﬁcant responsibility to ship compelling
software that delights millions, propelling Flipkart to new heights in Indian e-commerce.

Youʼll be responsible for
Shipping compelling software as part of a
cross-functional team.
Delivering products that delight a vast user
base daily.
Gaining exposure to business, marketing, product
development, brand, and engineering disciplines.
Taking on significant responsibility to provide
fresh perspectives and drive substantial
progress.

These things will set you up for success
Structured Thinking & Problem
Solving, curious mind with
exceptional analytical skills and
a technical foundation,
comfortable with data.

User Empathy & Product Sense
genuine interest in understanding
user needs and delivering solutions
that solve customer problems.

Exceptional Communication &
Organization, strong written and
verbal communication skills,
coupled with meticulous
organization and attention to
detail.

Go-Getter Attitude &
Entrepreneurial Spirit, proactive
mindset, preferably with a proven
track record of having built a
software/hardware product.

The CTC for the full time-role is 27.28 LPA
This includes components such as the base pay, variable pay,
ESOPs, and other benefits)

Hiring Process
Screening
Your profile will be evaluated for technical & functional
capabilities, relevant experience, and fitment for the role.
Online Assessment
Assessment can be in the form of a test (tech/non-tech),
group discussion, case study, problem-solving approach
or other relevant methods to assess your
technical/functional skills

Interviews
Typically 23 interview rounds in which we assess your engineering/functional skills, domain
expertise, and alignment with future fit and learning interest.

Offer Roll-out/LOI
Final selects will receive a letter of intent from Flipkart, and subsequently the offer letter.

Every Flipster is a Maximiser - Curious, Audacious, Entrepreneurial, Purpose-Driven, Excited By Big
Challenges, A Team Player and Inclusive. If this is who you are, then Flipkart is the place where you
can thrive.

To know more about our hiring programs, job opportunities, and the maximised life at
Flipkart, visit
